checked: Unsupported styles, transforms and path forms keep conservative box errors; only strict embedded template resources can override them.
Object viewBox meet scale/rotation are separate from glyph/text validation; actual margins and hole keepout reserve are retained.
Every filled path is tested independently; winding/evenodd cutouts cannot erase paint in another path.
Original resource fragment/bounds and exact source geometry are checked for start exemption; resource or transform edits remove exemption.
Existing clamp functions remain unmodified. Product/template/customer validation receives actual embedded resources; normal added motifs get no exemption.
Tests cover real Retro2 D12, repeated initial rendering, drag, resize, rotation, geometry/hole changes, missing/changed resources, authentic reselection and reverse-face reselection.
independentCodeReview.testsRun: No duplicate tests by reviewer; root owns final combined run.

D12 changes only the spruch baseline y by -0.77 mm (corrected from the initial -0.78 mm patch); text, font, size, motif and all other data are preserved.

D57 changes only text-2 Pielstädt to19.04 mm around the original centre, with documented millimetre rounding drift. Historical Corel source fields are retained.420×280 reaches99.96 mm;450×300 intentionally remains above100 mm as authorized.

This review verified patch scope, coordinate/metadata consistency and hashes. It did not repeat the numerical fit/clearance test suites.

The targeted680 follow-up retains the entire first reviewed log prefix; its correction entry records26.09→26.10 and total master movement−0.78→−0.77 mm. Existing proof gives0.2014/1.2678 mm clearance at90×60/120×80. No tests were rerun in this review.
